tools.name: insurance-intelligence_policy-normalize
tools.description: Normalize caller-supplied or locally extracted policy identity, term, and premium fields. Preliminary document analysis only—not coverage confirmation. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/policy-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_policy-limit-compare
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied left/right or prior/renewal coverage limits. Not a coverage determination. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/policy-limit-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_policy-exclusion-compare
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied exclusion schedules across prior/renewal or left/right sides. Preliminary text matching only. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/policy-exclusion-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_deductible-structure-extract
tools.description: Extract deductible/SIR amounts and apply-per structure from caller-supplied rows or local PDF text. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/deductible-structure-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_renewal-change-detect
tools.description: Detect insurer, premium, limit, and exclusion deltas between prior and renewal sides. Not insurer confirmation. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/renewal-change-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_premium-change-analyze
tools.description: Analyze prior versus renewal premium amounts from caller-supplied policy or premium rows. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/premium-change-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_coverage-gap-detect
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied contract requirements to supplied limits, deductibles, and exclusions. Preliminary gap signals only—not coverage confirmation. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/coverage-gap-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_loss-run-normalize
tools.description: Normalize caller-supplied loss-run claim rows into paid/reserved/incurred fields. Not a claim adjudication. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/loss-run-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_underwriting-evidence-completeness
tools.description: Check caller-supplied evidence items against a required checklist. Missing items are flagged; coverage is not confirmed. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/underwriting-evidence-completeness. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: insurance-intelligence_program-comparison
tools.description: Aggregate policy, limit, exclusion, deductible, premium, coverage-gap, and renewal comparisons from caller-supplied program records only. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/insurance-intelligence/program-comparison. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "insurance-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: insurance-intelligence_underwriting-evidence-completeness · Private data: insurance-intelligence_policy-normalize, insurance-intelligence_program-comparison · Public sink: insurance-intelligence_policy-normalize, insurance-intelligence_policy-limit-compare, insurance-intelligence_policy-exclusion-compare, insurance-intelligence_deductible-structure-extract, insurance-intelligence_renewal-change-detect, insurance-intelligence_premium-change-analyze, insurance-intelligence_coverage-gap-detect, insurance-intelligence_loss-run-normalize, insurance-intelligence_underwriting-evidence-completeness, insurance-intelligence_program-comparison · Destructive: insurance-intelligence_policy-normalize, insurance-intelligence_policy-limit-compare, insurance-intelligence_policy-exclusion-compare, insurance-intelligence_deductible-structure-extract, insurance-intelligence_renewal-change-detect, insurance-intelligence_premium-change-analyze, insurance-intelligence_coverage-gap-detect, insurance-intelligence_loss-run-normalize, insurance-intelligence_underwriting-evidence-completeness, insurance-intelligence_program-comparison.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
